content: npm audit natively supports --workspaces (audits all workspace packages from repo root in one pass) and --omit=dev to exclude devDependencies, plus --audit-level to set the CI failure severity threshold. It has no allowlist/accept-list mechanism of its own (must pair with a wrapper tool for that) and its advisory data is limited to the npm registry's own advisory database, narrower than OSV-Scanner's federated sources.
